'''Halrii''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[White Maw]] gang during the during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was part of [[Kandhar]]'s posse during a meeting with an Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Tarkus]]. The meeting was interrupted by the [[Voidhound]] who openly questioned Kandhar's motives in the deal. The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] responded by openly sentencing his men to death, after which they shot both him and the Imperial.<ref name="TOR" />
